faq.q: Which departure is closer to Marbella city centre?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about 6 km (10 minutes by car) from Marbella city centre, while Estepona Marina is roughly 20 km (20 minutes) away. If you're staying on the Golden Mile or in central Marbella, Puerto Banús is more convenient.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat from Estepona Marina with your fleet?
faq.a: Our entire fleet departs from Puerto Banús. We do not operate from Estepona Marina. However, many of our boats can cruise to Estepona as part of your itinerary, and you can be picked up from Estepona port by taxi or transfer.

faq.q: What are the typical distances to popular destinations from each marina?
faq.a: From Puerto Banús, Cala del Faro is 10 NM (30 min), Marbella Marina is 3 NM (10 min), and Sotogrande is 25 NM (1h 15min). From Estepona Marina, Cala Cortés is 12 NM (35 min), Gibraltar is 30 NM (1h 30min), and Marbella is 15 NM (45 min).

faq.q: Which marina has better facilities for charter guests?

faq.q: Is it cheaper to charter from Estepona Marina than Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Charter prices are generally similar, but parking and dining costs are lower in Estepona. Our boats are based in Puerto Banús, so there is no price difference for the charter itself—just the logistics of getting to the marina.

faq.q: Which marina is better for a sunset cruise?
faq.a: Both offer stunning sunsets over the Mediterranean. Puerto Banús provides a vibrant backdrop with the Sierra Blanca mountains, while Estepona Marina offers a quieter, more intimate setting. The choice depends on your preference for atmosphere.

faq.q: Can I combine a charter from Puerto Banús with a visit to Estepona?
faq.a: Yes. Many of our charters include a stop at Estepona Marina or its nearby coves. For example, a 4-hour charter from Puerto Banús can easily include a 30-minute cruise to Estepona, time for swimming, and a return trip.

faq.q: What is the best time of year for a 2039 charter from either marina?
faq.a: The Costa del Sol enjoys over 300 sunny days a year. May to October offers sea temperatures of 20-26°C and calm conditions. July and August are busiest in Puerto Banús; Estepona stays quieter year-round.

data.body_html:
Choosing between Puerto Banús and Estepona Marina for your 2039 yacht charter depends on your priorities: proximity to Marbella's Golden Mile, the size of the boat fleet, dining options, and parking costs. Both marinas are well-equipped, but they serve different travel styles. This guide breaks down the key differences—distance, facilities, and nearby attractions—so you can pick the departure point that fits your Costa del Sol plans. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, but we'll show you how Estepona compares as an alternative base.

Location & Accessibility

Puerto Banús sits in the heart of Marbella's luxury strip, the Golden Mile, just 6 km from Marbella city centre and 25 minutes from Málaga Airport (AGP). Estepona Marina is 20 km west of Marbella, about 45 minutes from the airport by car. If you're staying in central Marbella or the Golden Mile, Puerto Banús is the more convenient choice. For those based in Estepona or Sotogrande, Estepona Marina saves you a 20-minute drive east.

Fleet Size & Boat Options

Puerto Banús hosts our full fleet of 16 vessels, from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax). Estepona Marina has a smaller charter market with fewer boats and limited luxury options. If you need a specific model—like the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax)—Puerto Banús is your only option from our fleet. However, from Puerto Banús you can easily cruise to Estepona as part of your itinerary.

Distances to Popular Destinations

Estepona Marina is closer to Sotogrande and Gibraltar, while Puerto Banús gives faster access to Marbella's coves and the eastern Costa del Sol.

Facilities & Amenities

Puerto Banús offers luxury boutiques, Michelin-starred restaurants (e.g., Skina, Bibo), and 24/7 security. Estepona Marina has a relaxed, family-friendly vibe with tapas bars, a small sandy beach, and free parking. Both have fuel docks, water, and electricity. Parking at Puerto Banús costs around €30/day; Estepona Marina is €10/day. If you're on a budget, Estepona wins on parking and dining costs.

Charter Pricing & Inclusions

Our charter prices are the same regardless of departure point, but all boats are based in Puerto Banús. For example, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) starts at €749 for 2 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. If you prefer to depart from Estepona, you can arrange a transfer to Puerto Banús—it's a 20-minute taxi ride.

Atmosphere & Vibe

Puerto Banús is synonymous with glamour: superyachts, celebrity sightings, and nightlife that runs until dawn. Estepona Marina is quieter, more authentic, and popular with families and couples seeking a peaceful day on the water. For a sunset cruise, both offer stunning views, but Puerto Banús has the edge with its mountain backdrop and vibrant energy.

Which Should You Choose?

Pick Puerto Banús if you want the largest fleet, proximity to Marbella's luxury amenities, and a lively atmosphere. Choose Estepona Marina if you're staying in Estepona or Sotogrande, prefer lower parking costs, and want a quieter departure point. From our base in Puerto Banús, you can still visit Estepona as part of your charter—just ask your skipper to include it in the itinerary.
